title: More Stories - Women in Buddhism
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk touches on the complex history of women's inclusion in Buddhism, highlighting the story of Maha Prajapati's request to be ordained as a monk, which was eventually granted by the Buddha with certain restrictions. This anecdote serves as a reminder that even in ancient times, women were capable of spiritual awakening and leadership, and is used to challenge traditional misogyny in Buddhism. Nomon Tim Burnett believes that greater inclusivity and balance between men and women are essential for authentic Zen practice, and notes that their own tradition has made significant strides towards this goal.
